g.title: public.organizations
g.text: Tenant root. Single row today; every domain table hangs off organization_id for future multi-tenancy.

g.title: public.staff
g.text: Employees. Linked 1:1 to auth.users via user_id. Deactivated (active=false), never deleted. Self-editable personal fields are guarded by trg_guard_staff_self_update.
Whether this person appears as a provider in scheduling (columns, qualification pickers, slot search).

g.title: public.roles
g.text: Role definitions. system=true rows (super_admin, admin, front_desk, provider) cannot be deleted.

g.title: public.staff_invites
g.text: Tokenized invites (7-day expiry). Accepted atomically by accept_staff_invite() — service-role only. Partial unique index prevents duplicate pending invites per email.

g.title: public.services
g.text: The treatment catalog. duration_minutes is client-facing; buffers extend the blocked window. Prices in cents. requires_intake gates booking once intake forms exist. Deactivated, never deleted.
Cleanup/reset time appended to the blocked window; invisible to the client-facing times.

g.title: public.resource_types
g.text: Room categories services require (Massage Room, Facial Room, ...).

g.title: public.clients
g.text: Spa clients (no auth accounts). no_show_count is maintained by trigger from appointment status changes. flags is an extensible jsonb for operational booleans (requires_card_on_file).
Operational booleans, extendable without migrations. Known keys: requires_card_on_file

g.title: public.appointments
g.text: Never deleted — status lifecycle only (booked→confirmed→checked_in→in_progress→completed | cancelled | no_show). Double-booking of staff or rooms is impossible: gist exclusion constraints on the blocked window, which ignore cancelled/no_show rows so slots free themselves.
Start of the FULL blocked window including buffer_before — what all conflict checks use.
